name: Effective Caster
body:
Your spells affect more targets and bigger areas than others of your power level.

Prerequisite: Spellcasting attribute 17

Benefit: When determining the number of targets your spell can affect, or the size of its effect or area, you treat your caster level as if it were two higher.
